direction LR
functionalRequirement Authentication:::essential {
  id: "FR-01"
  text: "Every account must authenticate before opening private records"
  risk: high
  verifyMethod: test
}
interfaceRequirement Audit {
  id: "IR-02"
  text: "Every authentication result must produce an audit event"
  risk: medium
  verifyMethod: inspection
}
performanceRequirement Latency {
  id: "PR-03"
  text: "The p95 response time must remain below the service budget"
  risk: high
  verifyMethod: analysis
}
element Gateway {
  type: software
  docRef: service/gateway
}
element IntegrationTests {
  type: "automated test suite"
  docRef: tests/integration
}
Authentication - contains -> Audit
Authentication - traces -> Latency
Gateway - satisfies -> Authentication
IntegrationTests - verifies -> Authentication
